subject: Fix costflow pruned snapshot session splits
description: Fix remaining live /costflow attribution issue: the reconcile snapshot has session rows with path/id/total for historical Codex rollouts, but some rollout files have since been pruned from ~/.codex/sessions. taskTranscript returns null due fs.existsSync, so splitSessionTokens cannot assign represented session totals to durable-claim tasks, leaving large snapshot sessions as catch-all waste. In routes/analytics.js, when a claim's attribution session matches a represented session row, use that row's transcript/path as the grouping key even if the file is gone, and make usageOutputOnly return that session row's total from the snapshot before trying to re-read/sample the file. Keep absent-from-snapshot guard intact so out-of-source on-disk rollouts are not counted. Add regression where represented durable claim session row has total/path but the referenced rollout file is missing; /costflow still splits the snapshot total and subtracts catch-all.

summary: Fixed /costflow to attribute represented reconcile snapshot sessions even when their Codex rollout files have been pruned, while preserving the absent-from-snapshot guard. Verified with the requested costflow and usage tests.

Approved 1d89746b1. /costflow now uses represented snapshot session rows as grouping keys and returns snapshot totals before rereading transcript files, so pruned Codex rollouts can still be split and subtracted. Absent-from-snapshot guard remains intact. Focused tests pass from the attempt worktree.
